---
title: "Data_Cleaning"
output: html_document
---

```{r}
mmadness <- read.csv('ncaa_mbb_2001-2025_full.csv')

#second half of the file is duplicates where the opposite team is "team 1", so removing (at Prof Kumar's suggestion)
mmadness <- mmadness[1:1511, ]

# Analyzing the structure of the data 
str(mmadness)

# Looking at descriptive statistics 
summary(mmadness)

mmadness$winner <- ifelse(mmadness$winner == "team1", 1, 0)

mmadness$conf.2 <- as.factor(mmadness$conf.2)
mmadness$conf.1 <- as.factor(mmadness$conf.1)


str(mmadness)

# deleting non-relevant variables like names and where the data was found
mmadness$name.1 <- NULL
mmadness$link.1 <- NULL

mmadness$name.2 <- NULL
mmadness$link.2 <- NULL
mmadness$point_diff <- NULL
mmadness$year <- NULL

# some conferences are too small and can be only in one side of the train/testing so removing
mmadness$conf.1 <- NULL
mmadness$conf.2 <- NULL
```
```{r}
# Count missing values in each column
missing_counts <- colSums(is.na(mmadness))

# Remove columns with more than 20 missing values
mmadness <- 
  mmadness[, missing_counts <= 20]

# Check remaining missing values
colSums(is.na(mmadness))
```

#testing new convergence
```{r}
# Creating test/train ratio and splitting
ratio <- 0.7

set.seed(12345)
train_rows <- sample(1:nrow(mmadness), ratio*nrow(mmadness))


madness_train <- mmadness[train_rows, ]
madness_test <- mmadness[-train_rows, ]

# Creating initial model
logmodel <- glm(winner ~ ., data = madness_train, family = "binomial")
summary(logmodel)

# Predicting the testing data
madness_predict <- predict(logmodel, madness_test, type = "response")

madness_bin <- ifelse(madness_predict >= 0.5, 1, 0)

library(caret)
confusionMatrix(as.factor(madness_bin), as.factor(madness_test$winner), positive = "1")

```
